goal.en: Find out about the Outdoor Club and join it.
goal.zh: 了解戶外社，並報名加入。

background: school gym set up for a club fair, rows of folding tables, a table with a small tent, coiled ropes and a pair of hiking boots, colorful balloons, bright daylight

intro.en: It's club fair day. The gym is full of tables and noisy students.
intro.zh: 今天是社團博覽會，體育館擺滿攤位，學生們熱鬧滾滾。

lines.en: Hey there! Interested in the Outdoor Club?

choices.en: Maybe! What do you do in this club?
choices.zh: 也許！你們社團都做什麼？
choices.tip: What do you do in this club? 是問社團活動內容的自然說法。

choices.en: Yes. Your club is doing what activity?
choices.zh: 對。你們社團在做什麼活動？

lines.en: Right now? Um, standing at this table, I guess.
lines.zh: 現在嗎？呃，我猜是站在這張桌子旁邊吧。

story.en: Noah describes exactly what he's doing right now. You learn a lot about folding tables and nothing about the club.
story.zh: 諾亞詳細描述他此刻正在做的事。你學到很多摺疊桌的知識，卻對社團一無所知。

fail.why: 中文語序直譯成 is doing what，聽起來像在問「現在正在做什麼」。問社團活動要說 What do you do in this club?。

choices.en: Yes! I'm very interesting in hiking.

lines.en: You're interesting? Cool... Tell me more about you, then?
lines.zh: 你很有趣？酷……那多說說你自己？

story.en: Noah waits for you to say something interesting. The pressure is too much, and you only talk about the weather.
story.zh: 諾亞等著你說點有趣的事。壓力太大了，你只能聊天氣。

fail.why: interesting 是「令人感到有趣的」，interested 才是「感興趣的」。要說 I'm interested in hiking.。

lines.en: We go hiking, camping and even kayaking!
lines.zh: 我們會去健行、露營，還有划獨木舟！

choices.en: Sounds fun! How often do you meet?
choices.zh: 聽起來很好玩！你們多久聚一次？
choices.tip: How often...? 用來問頻率，回答會是 once a week、every Saturday 這類說法。

choices.en: Sounds fun! How many time you meet?
choices.zh: 聽起來很好玩！你們見面幾次？

lines.en: How many times... in total? Since 2019? Let me count.
lines.zh: 總共幾次……嗎？從 2019 年開始？我數一下。

story.en: Noah counts every club meeting since the club started. He gets to 213 before Leo stops him.
story.zh: 諾亞開始數社團成立以來的每一次聚會。數到 213 次時，里歐終於阻止了他。

fail.why: How many times 是問總共幾次，問頻率要用 How often。疑問句也要有助動詞：How often do you meet?。

choices.en: Kayaking? Isn't it dangerous? My mom says no.
choices.zh: 獨木舟？不危險嗎？我媽會說不行。

lines.en: Your mom? Uh, we always wear life jackets...
lines.zh: 你媽媽？呃，我們都會穿救生衣啦……

story.en: Noah gives you a safety brochure to show your mom. Leo signs up while you are still reading it.
story.zh: 諾亞給你一份安全手冊，讓你拿給媽媽看。你還在讀的時候，里歐已經報名了。

fail.why: 在國外，大學生多半自己做決定，搬出父母當理由會顯得不夠獨立。有疑慮可以直接問：Is it safe for beginners?。

lines.en: Every Saturday morning. The next trip is a lake hike!
lines.zh: 每個星期六早上。下次活動是湖邊健行！

choices.en: Great. How do I sign up?
choices.tip: sign up 是報名、註冊，sign up for + 活動。也可以說 How do I join?。

choices.en: Great. How can I enter the club?
choices.zh: 太好了。我要怎麼進社團？

lines.en: Enter? Well, the club room is on the second floor.

story.en: Noah draws you a map to the club room. You visit it, but there's nobody there on a Tuesday.
story.zh: 諾亞畫了一張社辦地圖給你。你真的去了，但星期二社辦一個人也沒有。

fail.why: 「進社團」直譯成 enter the club，聽起來像要走進社團教室。加入社團要說 join the club 或 sign up：How do I sign up?。

choices.en: Every Saturday? Saturday is my sleep day.
choices.zh: 每個星期六？星期六是我的睡覺日。

lines.en: Oh. Then maybe try the Sleeping Club?
lines.zh: 喔。那你也許該去睡覺社？

story.en: Noah turns to the next student. You spend Saturday in bed, and Leo sends you lake photos all morning.
story.zh: 諾亞轉向下一位學生。你星期六躺在床上，里歐整個早上都在傳湖景照片給你。

fail.why: 在別人熱情介紹時抱怨時間，聽起來很掃興。如果有興趣，直接問 How do I sign up?；時間不行，可以問 Do you have any trips on Sundays?。

lines.en: Just write your name and email here.
lines.zh: 在這裡寫下名字和 email 就好。

choices.en: Count me in! So what should I bring?
choices.zh: 算我一份！那我要帶什麼？
choices.tip: Count me in! 是「算我一份」，熱情加入時的說法。What should I bring? 主動問準備事項。

choices.en: Yes! I join. What I should bring?
choices.zh: 好！我加入。我應該帶什麼？

lines.en: "What I should bring"... is that a question or a list?
lines.zh: 「我應該帶的東西」……這是問題還是清單？

story.en: Noah waits for you to finish your list. You both stare at each other until Leo starts laughing.
story.zh: 諾亞等你把清單說完。你們互看了好久，直到里歐笑出來。

fail.why: 問句要倒裝：What should I bring?。說要加入可以用 I'm in! 或 Count me in!，不要說 I join.。

choices.en: Hmm, maybe. I'll think about it.

lines.en: Think about it? But you said you love hiking!
lines.zh: 考慮看看？可是你說過你超愛健行耶！

story.en: You think about it for three weeks. By then, the lake trip is full.
story.zh: 你考慮了三個星期。等你決定時，湖邊健行已經額滿了。

fail.why: 台灣人常用「我考慮看看」委婉拒絕或拖延，但想參加就要直接說。表達熱情加入：Count me in!。

lines.en: Good shoes, water and a snack. See you Saturday!
lines.zh: 好走的鞋、水和點心。星期六見！

story.en: You write your name on the sign-up sheet right under Leo's. Saturday can't come fast enough.
story.zh: 你在報名表上寫下名字，就在里歐的名字下面。好希望星期六快點到。

notes.en: What do you do in this club?
notes.explain: 問社團、組織平常的活動。用現在簡單式 do，表示平常的習慣。

example.en: What do you do in the Photo Club?

notes.explain: How often 問頻率，How many times 問總次數。回答 How often 可以用 once a week、every Saturday、twice a month。

example.en: How often do you go swimming? / Twice a week.
example.zh: 你多久游一次泳？／一週兩次。

notes.explain: sign up for 是報名活動、課程；join 是加入團體。不要說 enter the club，那是走進社團教室。

example.en: I signed up for the cooking class.

notes.explain: -ed 描述人的感受，-ing 描述事物的特質。I'm interested 是我感興趣，I'm interesting 是我這個人很有趣。

example.en: I'm interested in history. History is interesting.
example.zh: 我對歷史有興趣。歷史很有趣。

notes.explain: 英語文化欣賞直接表達熱情。想參加就說 Count me in! 或 I'm in!。說 I'll think about it. 通常會被理解成委婉拒絕。

example.en: A movie night on Friday? Count me in!
example.zh: 星期五電影之夜？算我一份！
